activeEvents.headline: Fed minutes show a divided September hike rationale while near-term October hike risk recedes.
activeEvents.direction: Mixed / modestly positive versus pre-minutes Fed risk
activeEvents.whyItMatters: The September 15-16 minutes showed policymakers agreed on the 25 bp hike but differed materially on why it was needed. Most participants still viewed another increase by year-end as likely, while softer jobs and inflation data reduced the probability of an October move. For Nasdaq, this separates easing near-term Fed policy risk from still-elevated long-end Treasury and term-premium pressure.
